name: Rescind E.R. Droid
description: The Rescind E.R. Droid was a type of modified DZ-70 fugitive tracker droid used during the Galactic Civil War. Droids of this kind was unarmed as it primarily filled a reconnaissance role. Rescind E.R. Droids were used by the Rak'qua on Station Gamma above Ord Mantell following the Battle of Yavin. In 1 ABY, a number of spacers who explored Station Gamma fought and destroyed multiple Rescind E.R. Droids.
